subject: FleetPilot POC impact recap + quote/call?
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@fleetpilot.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@fleetpilot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: FleetPilot POC impact recap + quote/call?

Hi Sofia / Rajiv,

Thanks again for running the POC with us — appreciate the team's time. Quick recap from our side with validated numbers from the week-long run on your staging traffic: 
- Median inference latency: down ~42% (p99 also improved, moved from ~420ms -> ~240ms)
- Sustained throughput: ~3.8x increase under your burst profile
- Estimated per-request token cost: ~38% reduction after batching + KV-cache (~$0.037 -> $0.023 per request on our Dedicated config)
- No data residency changes required for this POC (stayed in your eu-west sandbox as requested)

I've attached the short pilot-results.pdf with charts and the baseline vs optimized curves.

Two quick asks:
1) Would you be willing to share a one-line endorsement we can use in a customer highlight? Something obvious like: "Redwood helped us reduce inference latency and lower costs during our POC" — but whatever you're comfortable with.
2) Can we grab 15 minutes next week for a quick on-camera quote or a short audio clip (we'll schedule at your convenience)?

If yes to either, I can draft a suggested one-liner to speed things up. No pressure — happy to make this as minimal as you'd like.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[d] 415-555-0123 | dylan@redwood.com
Attachment: pilot-results.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime

Hi Dylan,

Great recap — thank you for the clear write-up and the PDF. The numbers match what we saw in our dashboards; the latency and cost wins are real and material for our UIs.

We're happy to provide a short quote. Suggested one-liner from my side (feel free to edit):
"Using Redwood Inference in our POC, FleetPilot reduced LLM inference latency by ~42% and lowered per-request costs by roughly 38%."

I'm available for a 15-minute call next Tuesday (June 9) between 10:00–12:00 PT. Rajiv can also join. If that works, send a calendar invite.

Thanks — happy to help with a short public blurb.

- Permission to use that quote on our website and in a short case study? (we'll send a draft and can make edits as you request)
- If you'd prefer we soften the explicit percentage numbers for public copy, we can offer an alternative that keeps the statement directional (e.g., "significantly reduced latency and lowered per-request costs").

I'll go ahead and pencil in Tue 9 June at 10:30 PT if that works for Rajiv — sending a tentative calendar invite now.

Marissa / Grace — looping you two for a quick micro-case write and to own the draft once Sofia confirms permission. Log a small ask in the marketing tracker (FP-2026-49) and I'll add the artifacts to the shared Drive.

Thanks again,
Dylan
